goal: Independently collect and analyze all local and online evidence needed before RICON Reforger implementation, then cross-audit Claude and Codex corpora for completeness, integrity, validity, quality, contradictions, and unresolved gaps.
known_facts: fact_001: Reforger Tools Steam build 24870687 and Workbench 1.8.0.13 are installed; game app 1874880 remains incomplete with build id 0.
fact_002: Official VoNComponent API exposes SetCapture, SetCommMethod, one SetTransmitRadio argument, OnReceive(receiver/frequency/quality), and server OnVoNUsed.
fact_003: BaseTransceiver exposes frequency, transceiver-wide mute, and server-owner range control; BaseRadioComponent exposes multiple transceivers, key, power, and synchronized tuning.
fact_004: RelayTransceiver and IntercomTransceiver public pages expose no dedicated behavior beyond inherited BaseTransceiver members.
fact_005: Official Audio Editor documentation supports graphical ACP chains and signals fed from script, entity SignalsManagerComponent, or global signals.
fact_006: No evidence yet binds a script-set signal to the vanilla VoN stream for one talker-listener pair.
fact_007: Official Rpl docs expose connection-specific streaming but warn about performance; multiplayer docs say streaming-out with authority present is undefined and should be avoided.
fact_008: Dedicated servers do not instantiate BaseSoundComponent, so audible processing is necessarily client-side even when policy is server-authoritative.
fact_009: Workbench addon setup officially requires installed Reforger game data; the incomplete game install blocks a valid project/compile proof.
fact_010: Official autotests execute through World Editor/game runtime, so they are outside the current no-Play permission boundary.
fact_011: Official Workshop docs require rights to all uploaded content, package sources separately, and retain only the last 50 Workshop versions.
fact_012: Official Workshop Terms allow custom licenses only under specific non-commercial and Bohemia-product restrictions.
fact_013: Bohemia Game Content Usage Rules explicitly prohibit reverse engineering or hacking game files; planned RE remains legally blocked absent a stronger specific permission or legal basis.
fact_014: Local BaseTransceiver API prose appears to swap GetMinFrequency/GetMaxFrequency descriptions, so names and behavior need later runtime/source verification.
fact_015: Static evidence can support DOC/SOURCE/COMPILE claims only; VoN, relay, Rpl, performance, BattlEye, and audio remain runtime-blocked.
rejected_branches: Treating RelayTransceiver type existence as proof of forwarding
Treating OnReceive quality as proof of writable VoN quality
Treating owner approval alone as legal authorization for reverse engineering
